notes: v2 of the API (OWN gateway base path /realtime-web-search/v2 via own_slug; RapidAPI serves the same routes at the host root). /search: offset pagination via 'start', 'num' 1-10 per call, organic results in data.organic_results. /search-light: one call returns up to 300 results ('num'). AI Mode is POST-only here; AI Overviews is its own API (see ai-overviews).
